body.heading: Where in the world is Timor-Leste?
paragraphs: Timor-Leste is a country in Southeast Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Timor-Leste is Dili.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Timor-Leste speak Tetum and Portuguese. Tetum is the language most people speak every day; Portuguese is also official, a link from the past.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Timor-Leste is the US dollar. Yes — the very same dollars used in the United States!

body.heading: How big is Timor-Leste?
paragraphs: Timor-Leste covers about 15,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Armenia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Atauro, a short boat ride from Dili, has some of the most diverse coral reefs on Earth — scientists found more reef fish species here than anywhere else.
A giant statue of Christ stands on a globe above the sea at Dili's edge — climb the steps for sweeping views, then swim at the beaches below.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Timor-Leste on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
